name: nodegoat
scope: Four manually reviewed file-level cases. Not an audit of the application. No target code was executed.
limitations: Role 'held-out': do not tune scanner rules against this target; use it only to measure generalization.
The $where case uses a collection .find() call that the JavaScript database catalog does not model; it is a known miss.

cases.rationale: Request body fields are passed to eval.
The redirect target is taken directly from the query string.
Redirects use a fixed local path.
cases.queue_comparable_reason: The file also contains login and database operations, so file-level queue rank cannot isolate the fixed-path redirects (CWE-601). The case still counts as a finding-level negative.

cases.rationale: A request-supplied threshold is interpolated into a $where JavaScript expression.
